title: LLM Analysis of 150+ years of German Parliamentary Debates on Migration Reveals Shift from Post-War Solidarity to Anti-Solidarity in the Last Decade
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks LLMs on their ability to detect 'solidarity' and 'anti-solidarity' in political discourse, which the authors explicitly define and categorize as 'differentiated moral frames.' The study uses subtypes such as compassionate and empathic solidarity to measure how well models handle complex societal and moral values.
